parameters.label: King range
parameters.description: How many squares the King may move in one move.
parameters.notes: Higher values change what counts as an attack. Flag combinations for simulation.

parameters.label: King can jump
parameters.description: Whether the King may pass over occupied squares.

parameters.label: Queen can enter void squares
parameters.description: Whether the Queen may cross or occupy void squares.

parameters.label: Queen entry into enemy territory
parameters.description: Whether the Queen may enter the opponent's half only through gateway squares or anywhere.
parameters.notes: Which squares are gateways must be defined in the board data.

parameters.label: Pawn double step
parameters.description: Whether a standard pawn may advance two squares on its first move.

parameters.label: Pawn promotion targets
parameters.description: Which pieces an eligible pawn may promote to.
parameters.notes: Open question in the v1 plan. No default chosen.

parameters.label: Sun and Moon pawn range
parameters.description: How many squares a Sun or Moon pawn may move, in any direction.

parameters.label: Sun and Moon pawn promotion
parameters.description: Whether Sun and Moon pawns may promote.

parameters.label: Dragon range
parameters.description: How far a Dragon may move in one move.

parameters.label: Dragon range mode
parameters.description: Whether the Dragon's range counts squares in one direction or separate moves.
parameters.notes: Open question in the v1 plan. No default chosen.

parameters.label: Dragon can jump
parameters.description: Whether a Dragon may pass over occupied squares.

parameters.label: Dragons in 2-player games
parameters.description: Whether frozen Dragons block their starting squares or are removed from the board.
parameters.notes: Open question in the v1 plan. No default chosen.

parameters.label: Stalemate result
parameters.description: The result when the player to move has no legal move and is not in check.
